create_conv_nd: create a 1D, 2D, or 3D convolution module using conv_nd with specified dimensions and channels
create_avg_pool_nd: create a 1D, 2D, or 3D average pooling module using avg_pool_nd with specified dimensions
update_ema_params: update target parameters using exponential moving average with update_ema and a specified rate
zero_module_params: zero out all parameters of a PyTorch module using zero_module and return the module
create_timestep_embedding: create sinusoidal timestep embeddings for diffusion models using timestep_embedding with a specified dimension
